claims: Bret Bielema is the head football coach for the University of Illinois Fighting Illini.
Bret Bielema has held the position of head football coach for the University of Illinois Fighting Illini since December 2020.
Bret Bielema has guided the University of Illinois Fighting Illini to three bowl games.
Bret Bielema guided the University of Illinois Fighting Illini to the 2024 Citrus Bowl.
Bret Bielema guided the University of Illinois Fighting Illini to the 2025 Music City Bowl.
Bret Bielema signed an extension in 2025 to lead the University of Illinois football program through 2030.
In 2026, Bret Bielema is the head coach of Illinois football.
In 2026, Barry Lunney Jr. is the Offensive Coordinator/QBs for Illinois football.
In 2026, Bobby Hauck is the Defensive Coordinator for Illinois football.
In 2026, Chris Hurd is the Special Teams Coordinator for Illinois football.
In March 2026, Illinois announced several staff updates including Chris Hurd as Special Teams Coordinator.
In March 2026, Illinois announced Archie McDaniel as Outside Linebackers coach.
In March 2026, Illinois announced Mike Neu as Pass Game Coordinator.
Thomas Hammock was the head coach at Northern Illinois University (NIU) since 2019.
Thomas Hammock resigned in February 2026 to join the Seattle Seahawks staff.
